title: Read streams from runner.isolation() inside the with block, not after it

note.title: Read streams from runner.isolation() inside the with block, not after it
answers: ValueError I/O operation on closed file in test_testing
how to assert on stderr bytes from CliRunner.isolation
note.body:
Convention, from a review comment: the stream objects yielded by `CliRunner.isolation()` (including `err`) can be closed when the context manager exits. Exiting drops the reference to the internal StreamMixer, so GC can run StreamMixer.__del__, which closes stderr, stdout and output.
Call `getvalue()` and make assertions inside the `with runner.isolation() as (out, err, _):` block. See tests/test_testing.py:test_isolation_stderr_errors and test_isolation_flushes_unflushed_stderr.
After the block exits, only use the captured values on `Result` (from `runner.invoke`), not the raw yielded streams.
